_note: Every numeric value the recovered AI tree needs is either a float from
adreno_200/characters.list (ai_profile), a float stored in ai/standard.tree
(param / params_by_difficulty), or one of the entries below.
status RECOVERED  = value comes from original data or original code, with
status UNRECOVERED = the original value is not present in the recovered
assets/decompilation; the value is a declared port
parameter and MUST NOT be read as original behaviour.

difficulty_index.basis: standard.tree stores five params_by_difficulty slots ([0.3,0.2,0.1,0,0] etc.). Which slot the arcade/story match passes is a CBeatEmUpGame::Init argument (0x18aa08, params 3..8) and is not recoverable from the assets alone.

distance_close_reach_factor.basis: The native `distance` variable is written by CBeatEmUpGame::Update (ELF 0x18c1bc, ghidra 0x19c1bc) from a float field; the close/medium thresholds themselves are not in the recovered data. 1.0 x PortFighter.attack_reach_world() reproduces the port's already-validated native reach.

distance_medium_reach_factor.basis: Same variable as above; medium band bound is a declared port parameter.

arena_limit_margin.basis: `near_limits` is computed by code that is not in the recovered decompilation; the margin to PortFighter.ARENA_HALF_X is a declared port parameter.

attacktofloor_windows.basis: candobasicattacks group member window per fighting set (tools/kdf_combo_group_inventory.py) plus the direct attacktofloor->idle2 link time.
